description:
We are Hidden Gems, a team passionate about space exploration, technology, and creativity. Our goal is to bring forgotten space equipment back into the spotlight by exploring why it was sent into space, how it worked, what discoveries it made, and why it was eventually left behind. Through research, storytelling, and innovation, we aim to make space history engaging and accessible to everyone.

Let’s uncover the stories the universe left behind. 💎
summary:
OFF-WORLD is an interactive narrative exploration experience where an alien expedition discovers humanity through the machines we left behind in space.

In 2231, humanity broadcasts an emergency signal into the universe. Years later, the Kalamithians receive it, decode its meaning, and begin a sixteen-year journey to the source. When they arrive, nobody answers.

Players take the role of the expedition’s explorer and investigate humanity through real NASA missions, spacecraft, rovers, scientific instruments, and mission data. They encounter Voyager 1 and its Golden Record, investigate robotic exploration on Mars, and explore human equipment left on the Moon. Instead of simply reading facts, players identify unfamiliar objects, decode information, reconstruct their purposes, solve scientific challenges, and interpret evidence.

The experience combines real space exploration history with a fictional first-contact mystery, making NASA science part of an emotional investigation. By the time the expedition reaches Earth, players have discovered humanity through its curiosity, exploration, and attempts to communicate—making its final silence meaningful.
details:
Off-World is an interactive science-fiction experience that explores one haunting question: What if humanity sent a distress signal into space, but help arrived only after humanity had disappeared?

Set in the year 2231, the story begins with Earth's civilization collapsing as power grids, industries, supply chains, and public knowledge fail. Two political blocs must cooperate to send a distress message to the Kalamith, an alien civilization on Proxima Centauri b. Players participate in this process through meaningful decisions and interactive challenges, including repairing systems, negotiating over an encryption key, assembling a transmission, and helping decode the message.

The experience then follows the signal across interstellar space. The Kalamith receive and decode it, launch an expedition, and eventually arrive at a silent Earth. Through orbital scans and archived conversations with ARCHIVE-9, the last surviving artificial intelligence, players uncover humanity's fate. The journey continues through an interactive Voyager 1 object-recovery experience, where users explore the spacecraft and its Golden Record, before moving to a Mars survey featuring an ice prospect at Arcadia Planitia.

Off-World combines interactive storytelling, scientific exploration, and immersive 3D environments. Rather than presenting information through ordinary articles, it turns the narrative into an experience where users interact with spacecraft, inspect objects, solve challenges, make decisions, and gradually uncover the story.

The project was developed using React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, GSAP, Zustand, and CSS, with the Web Audio API for sound and interaction feedback. Its visual experience combines 3D planetary environments, animated spacecraft, camera transitions, starfields, and a retro-inspired computer interface.

Its creativity lies in connecting a fictional future with recognizable space exploration concepts and real scientific locations. The project aims to encourage curiosity about space, planetary science, spacecraft, and humanity's responsibility to preserve knowledge. We considered narrative clarity, scientific context, interaction design, accessibility, visual immersion, and performance while developing the experience.
